title: Business Process in Ready that is mapped: make it Operational
cardHint: A Business Process in Ready has its CIA values and something linked below: SACM makes it Operational.
cardText: A Business Process is created in Ready. After the BIA its CIA values are added: that is the sign to map it. To map: nothing is linked below yet, so the process is a case of the Mapping backlog, where SACM plans a mapping session with the process owner. Mapped: a Business Application or Business Service is linked below, so SACM makes the process Operational: that is the line of this card. A process in Ready without CIA values waits for the BIA: it has no line, and nobody is chased. Needs the Relationship report.
